history.summary: A Durga shrine on Station Road, Jharsuguda, listed as 'Kanak Durga Mandir' (place listing shows hours 4:30 AM-9:45 PM daily). Location identity is solid (Station Road geocode confirms the listing), but no published history, founding date, patron or festival calendar was found - all such details must be verified on the ground. Not to be confused with the famous Kanaka Durga Temple of Vijayawada (Andhra Pradesh). CSV town 'Jharsuguda' is correct.

name: Maa Kanak Durga Temple
town_description: Jharsuguda is an industrial city of western Odisha (the 'powerhouse of Odisha') with its own airport, Veer Surendra Sai Airport. It has several local temples including Pahadi Mandir, the Kanak Durga shrine on Station Road, and the Ramachandi cave temple near Brajrajnagar. Coordinates are geocoded to Durga Mandir, Station Road, Jharsuguda 768201.
